simple.meaning: לְבָנוֹן (Lᵉbânôwn) appears 71 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced in connection with kingship.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Deuteronomy, Joshua, Judges, 1 Kings, 2 Kings, and 11 more, beginning at Deuteronomy 1:7. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as kingship, land, mountain, wilderness, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to לְבָנוֹן (H3844) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows לְבָנוֹן through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.
simple.summary: לְבָנוֹן (Lᵉbânôwn) / H3844 is tracked through Deuteronomy 1:7, Deuteronomy 3:25, Deuteronomy 11:24, Joshua 1:4. The entry is generated from source alignment, occurrence evidence, and the surrounding Scripture context.

all the storage cities that Solomon had, the cities for his chariots, the cities for his horsemen, and that which Solomon desired to build for his pleasure in Jerusalem, and in Lebanon, and in all the land of his dominion.
he made three hundred shields of beaten gold; three minas§ A mina is about 600 grams or 1.3 U. S. pounds. of gold went to one shield; and the king put them in the House of the Forest of Lebanon.

definitions.short: Lebanon , a mountain range in Palestine
definitions.full: H3844. Lebanon לְבָנוֺן ( Deut 3:25 הַלְּבָנֹן van d. H.) 71 proper name, of a mountain Lebanon (Phoenician לבנן ; Assyrian Labnanu , etc., Schr COT on 1Kin 5:13 , Dl Par. 103 ff. ; Egyptian Ra-m­n-n WMM Asien u.Europa,197ff. ; Arabic compare further Rob BR ii, 435ff. 493GASm Geogr.45ff. Buhl Geogr.110 and references ; name probably from whiteness of its cliffs Rob BR ii, 493 ); — wooded mountain-range on northern border of Israel [usually with article ׳הַלּ (51 t.); without article לְבָנוֺן , in poetry and late Hosea 14:8 ; Nahum 1:4 ; 2Kin 19:23 = Isa 37:24 ; Ezek 31:15-16 , Isa 14:8 ; 29:17 ; 33:9 ; 40:16 ; Jer 18:14 ; Hab 2:17 ; Zech 10:10 ; 11:1 ; Psa 29:6 ; Song 4:8 (twice in verse); 4:11 , 15 ; with ה locative לְבָב֫וֺנָה 1 Kings 5:28a]; perhaps first mentioned in defining a locality, as הַלְּבָנוֺן הַר , Judg 3:3 (E according to GFM; this combination only here), but also in early prophets, then in D, and later; — in defining a locality Josh 9:1 ; הַלּ ׳בִּקְעַת 11:17 ; 12:7 (side of Baal Gad); as a marked feature, in describing extent of land Deut 1:7 ; 3:25 ; 11:24 ; Josh 1:4 ; 13:5 ( כָּלהַֿל ) 13:6 (all D), 1Kin 9:19 2Chr 8:6 ; Jer 22:26 ; Zech 10:10 ; ׳אשׁהַל׳ר Jer 22:6 (figurative of royal house of Judah), as a height Song 4:8 (twice in verse); הַל ׳מִגְדַּל Cant 7:5 i.e. a tower built on Lebanon; ל ׳שֶׁלֶג Jer 18:14 snow of L. ; L. as source of streams Song 4:15 ; ל ׳יֵין Hosea 14:8 ; most often, however, as bearing forests, especially of cedars, הַלּ ׳אַרְזֵי Judg 9:15 (in allegory; perhaps J, according to GFM), Isa 2:13 ; 14:8 ; Psa 29:5 ; 104:16 , compare 1Kin 5:13 ; 1 Kings 5:20; 1 Kings 5:23; 1 Kings 5:28 (twice in verse); 2Chr 2:7 (twice in verse); 2:15 , 2Kin 14:9 (twice in verse) = 2Chr 25:18 (twice in verse) (in allegory), Jer 22:23 ; Ezek 17:3 ; 27:5 ; 31:3 , 15 , 16 ; Zech 11:1 ; Ezra 3:7 ; Psa 92:13 ; Song 3:9 ; 5:15 (simile of majestic figure); ל ׳מֶּרַח Nahum 1:4 ; הַלּ ׳כְּבוֺד Isa 35:2 ; 60:13 ; ל ׳וְשָׁב לְכַרְמֶל 29:17 ׅ || ל ׳יַרְכְּתֵי (יַעַר with the same reference 37:24 = 2Kin 19:23 ; ׳הַלּ = trees of Lebanon Hosea 14:6 ; Isa 10:34 ; 40:16 ; Psa 29:6 ; 72:16 ; ׳ל Isa 33:9 figurative, as mourning; ל ׳חֲמַס Hab 2:17 i.e. violence done to Lebanon , probably by cutting down its trees; הַלּ יַעַר ׳בֵּית a royal mansion of Solomon, 1Kin 7:2 ; and 10:17 , 21 2Chr 9:16 , 20 ; ׳ל as home of wild beast 2Kin 14:9 2Chr 25:18 (in allegory); לְבָנוֺן רֵיחַ , of the odour of cedar forests Song 4:11 , compare Hosea 14:7 (in simile; We thinks ׳ל here to be a specific plant).
